candidates.title: Hotel Metropolitan Tokyo Marunouchi
candidates.summary: Tokyo Station hotel candidate with unusually strong rail convenience for first-time city logistics.
candidates.details: Compare direct rates, room size, cancellation terms, and Tokyo Station access before booking.
caveats: Verify current rates, fees, and availability.

candidates.title: Nohga Hotel Ueno Tokyo
candidates.summary: Ueno-area hotel candidate with easier museum and market access than a pure business-district stay.
candidates.details: Useful if the itinerary leans toward Ueno Park museums, Ameyoko, and northeast Tokyo transit.
caveats: Verify room type, breakfast policy, and cancellation terms.

candidates.title: Nakiryu
candidates.summary: Michelin-recognized ramen stop to compare for a food-focused Tokyo itinerary.
candidates.details: Treat as a high-demand candidate; verify current queue/ticketing expectations and hours.
caveats: Hours and queue process can change.

candidates.title: Ameyoko Shopping Street
candidates.summary: Lively Ueno market/shopping area for snacks, casual browsing, and a less-polished street-market feel.
candidates.details: Best as a flexible walkable block paired with Ueno Park or a Ueno hotel base.

candidates.title: Tokyo National Museum
candidates.summary: Major Ueno museum anchor for Japanese art/history and a strong rainy-day or culture-first block.
candidates.details: Pair with Ueno Park and nearby food; verify open days, special exhibitions, and ticket rules.

candidates.title: Narita Express / airport rail comparison
candidates.summary: Airport-transfer decision point: compare Narita Express, Keisei Skyliner, taxi, or Haneda rail based on arrival airport and hotel area.
candidates.details: Do not choose until flights and hotel base are known.
caveats: Route depends on arrival airport, hotel area, luggage, and arrival time.
